# Frozen model parameter inventory

Read-only audit, 12 November 2026. Each row gives the original encoded input mean, scale, standardised coefficient and effective raw-input slope (coefficient / scale). These are conditional logits, not percentages of model importance or causal effects. Zero-imputation and mean-imputation differ by model; retain the original definition. Base and adjustment scores are added before race softmax.
